description: Cross-PDK validation: TSMC model -> ASAP7 test cells (11D node features)

_comments.cross_pdk_note: This config validates TSMC-trained models on ASAP7 test cells. Tests cross-PDK generalization.
_comments.node_features: 11D: 7 base electrical + param_a + param_b + param_c + temperature (same for both PDKs)
_comments.use_target_norm_note: If true, use ASAP7 norm_stats for test data normalization (recommended for cross-PDK due to different feature scales)
_comments.pdk_scale_factor_note: Scale factor for ASAP7 units (ps/ff) to TSMC units (ns/pf). Use 0.001 to convert ASAP7 to TSMC scale. Applies to input_slew, output_load, and output values.
_comments.voltage_shift_note: Voltage shift to align ASAP7 (nominal 0.7V) to TSMC (nominal 0.9V). Use 0.2 to shift ASAP7 voltages by +0.2V.
_comments.normalization_note: If use_target_norm=false, uses TSMC norm_stats from model checkpoint to normalize ASAP7 test data
_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage on all nodes), vdd_only (voltage only on VDD, 0 elsewhere)
_comments.normalization_options: zscore (z-score normalization, default), minmax (min-max to [epsilon, 1] range)
_comments.temp_mode_options: typical (temp on MOS only, default), temp_all (temp on all nodes)
_comments.adaptation_method_options: selective_adam (grad/move + conditional Adam), adam (direct Adam, no grad/move)
_comments.tsmc_cache_path_note: Path to TSMC topology cache (for checkpoint suffix detection). gatectrl/bidir are auto-detected.
_comments.asap7_cache_path_note: Path to ASAP7 topology cache (for test data adjacency). If empty, default ASAP7 cache is used.
_comments.inputport_note: Set 'inputport': true if using inputport topology. Applies to both TSMC model and ASAP7 test data.
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set 'related_pin_only': true if using related_pin_only slew assignment.
